question: 2025年下半年实付销售额高于上半年、且增长幅度最大的是哪些收货地区？（请给出地区、上半年额、下半年额与增长百分比）
gold_sql: WITH region_sales AS (SELECT o.region, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) <= '06' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS h1, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) >= '07' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS h2 FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region) SELECT region, ROUND(h1, 2) AS first_half, ROUND(h2, 2) AS second_half, ROUND((h2 - h1) * 100.0 / h1, 2) AS growth_pct FROM region_sales WHERE h2 > h1 ORDER BY growth_pct DESC, region
notes: Task 13 评测失败自动沉淀；供 Task 14 分析
